disclaimer: Example onboarding policy written for a hackathon demo. Not a real company's policy. Daily stop targets below are policy-defined ramp limits, not predictions of a worker's productivity.

review.rule: R-REV-1: If the CV and questionnaire disagree on delivery experience by more than 1 year, or a fact the track depends on is uncertain, a manager must resolve it before the plan can be approved.

tracks.label: Experienced Courier track
tracks.rule: R-TRACK-1: An expert recommendation in classifier demo mode plus a license selects Experienced. Without a usable classifier, at least 2 CV parcel years plus a license qualifies.

tracks.label: Courier Foundations track
tracks.rule: R-TRACK-2: Everyone else starts on Foundations: three ride-along days, then a gradual ramp that reaches the standard route in week 4.

tracks.label: Intermediate Courier track
tracks.rule: R-TRACK-3: An okay recommendation in classifier demo mode plus a license selects targeted refreshers, two mentor days and a moderate ramp. A manager approves every plan.

modules.title: Safety, hazmat awareness and incident reporting
modules.rule: R-MOD-1: Required for every new worker regardless of experience.

modules.title: Hours-of-service and break rules
modules.rule: R-MOD-2: Required for every new worker.

modules.title: Handheld scanner and proof of delivery
modules.rule: R-MOD-3: Required for everyone; prior handheld scanner use shortens it to a 30-minute refresher on the Fleetwing app.

modules.title: Safe lifting and hand-truck technique
modules.rule: R-MOD-4: Required for every new worker.

modules.title: Pre-trip box truck inspection
modules.rule: R-MOD-5: Required for anyone who will drive a Fleetwing vehicle.

modules.title: Defensive driving course
modules.rule: R-MOD-6: Foundations takes the full defensive-driving course; Intermediate takes a two-hour refresher before solo driving.

modules.title: Customer handoff, signatures and damaged-package reporting
modules.rule: R-MOD-7: Customer handoff training on Foundations; a one-hour refresher on Intermediate.

modules.title: Route sequencing in the Fleetwing dispatch app
modules.rule: R-MOD-8: Experienced and Intermediate couriers learn Fleetwing's dispatch app instead of general route training.

modules.title: Mentor ride-along
modules.rule: R-MOD-9: One mentor day on Experienced, two on Intermediate, three on Foundations.

modules.title: Fleetwing courier app basics
modules.rule: R-MOD-10: Added for anyone who hasn't used a delivery or route app before.

modules.title: Scanner practice lab with a mentor
modules.rule: R-MOD-11: Added when a worker rates their scanning confidence 1 or 2.

modules.title: Depot area orientation: zones, docks and tricky addresses
modules.rule: R-MOD-12: Added when a worker is new to the depot's area or rates navigation 1 or 2.

scheduleRule: R-SCHED-1: Ride-along and on-route days start at the worker's preferred shift time.

tailoring.workerNote: An area orientation with your mentor, since you're new to the area.
An area orientation with your mentor, to make navigation easier from day one.
A one-hour walkthrough of the courier app, since it's new to you.
An extra scanner practice session with a mentor, so scanning feels easy before you're on route.
The customer handoff and signatures session, to build confidence at the door.

tailoringRule: R-TAILOR-1: Tailoring only adds or lengthens training. It never removes a required module or changes the stop ramp.
